crop.notes: Whole 'Local Short Stops' column; only the item on James Scott vs. Michael McCoole (in crop-2) mentions Allen.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Offered as Witness in McCoole Debt Suit

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that a $900 borrowed-money suit by James Scott of Detroit against Mike McCoole was continued after McCoole's lawyer offered Tom Allen as a witness that McCoole was too sick to appear.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Friday, September 26, 1873' with the masthead 'Daily Democrat' (before the May 1875 merger, so not yet the Globe-Democrat).

facts.fact: Allen was offered as a witness that Mike McCoole was too sick to appear in a $900 debt suit brought by James Scott of Detroit in Judge Knight's court, St. Louis; the case was continued

notes: The current title mentions theater notices, which are not in this clipping.
